evidenceBoundary.pathNames: selected from the exact parent manifest by bounded identity tokens; no Chapter 2 path is treated as a receipt before manifest verification
evidenceBoundary.rule: The recovery tool must verify the exact parent archive, discover one authoritative manifest, select matching records, and verify each emitted file against its manifest byte count and SHA-256. Missing classifications produce source-required status and exit code 3; contradictory custody fails with exit code 2.
